review_method: Actual view_image inspection of all six previews; final_mip_unclipped full-resolution PNG also viewed
observations: PureCompton shows strong concentric rings and spotted peaks that become more prominent with iteration.
The joint final MIP is visually close to SC; strong pureCompton ring/spot features are substantially reduced, while blurred boundaries and nonuniform background remain.
13mm hot-sphere recovery is limited in both SC and joint; no 13mm resolution certification is claimed.
CNR/BV curves preserve the pureCompton negative13mm CNR, late BV increase, and BV-CNR trajectory turns.
Shared unclipped scale makes all methods lighter but exposes the pureCompton maximum55.37 without per-image rescaling.
limitations: Execution/transfer/numerical QA is separate from physical response validation.
Improvement is not uniform across sphere sizes:13mm CNR decreases,22mm is similar,37mm slightly improves.
These displays do not establish that the cause of Compton rings has been fixed.
No smoothing, brightness fitting, XY crop, or218/440cross-energy sum was applied.
